title: BUGFIX — ScriptAgent LLM rewrite always times out when briefs > 5
rationale: ScriptAgent in LLM rewrite mode processes all N briefs sequentially at ~2 min each (qwen3:14b). For 11 briefs = 22 min, but stage-5 timeout is 10 min. Result: always times out, 0 scripts produced every live run with qualified clips. Fix: cap LLM rewrites at 5 briefs (5 × 2 min = 10 min, fits within timeout). Remaining briefs get deterministic fallthrough within the same stage. Total bundle count is still N — no loss in video output.

tasks.description: In agents/scs001-orchestrator/index.ts stage-5: cap LLM-rewritten briefs at 5. Remaining briefs beyond cap processed deterministically (agent.run) and concatenated to bundles. 5 × ~2min = ~10min stays within 600s stage timeout.
